description: This file defines the IntegerDistribution interface for integer-based probability distributions as part of the Apache Commons Math3 library.

classes.name: IntegerDistribution
classes.description: Interface for distributions on the integers defining methods for probability, cumulative probability, quantiles, support bounds, and sampling.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Returns the probability mass function value at x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Returns the cumulative distribution function value at x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Returns the probability that X is between x0 and x1.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Returns the smallest x such that P(X <= x) >= p.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether the support is connected.

methods.name: reseedRandomGenerator
methods.description: Reseeds the random generator with a new seed.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the distribution.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a sample of specified size.
